Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RETRACTOR, ANTERIOR VAGINAL WALL (SIM'S PATTERN) 



1. Scope— Dimensional and other requirements for anterior vaginal wall retractor (Sim's pattern). 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown In Fig. I.

FIG. I RETRACTOR. ANTERIOR VAGINAL WALL (SIM'S PATTERN) 



3. Material — Stainless steel. Designation 22Cr!3 or 30Cr!3of Schedule V of !S : !S70-!96I 'Schedules 
for wrought steels for general engineering purposes*. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 Aii the surfaces of the retractor shaii be free from burrs, pits, cracks and other surface flaws and, 
except the serrated parts of the blades, shall be snrtooth. 

4.2 The blades shall nowhere be sharp, 

4.3 The retractor shaii be passlvated and polished bright. 

5. Heat Treatment— -The instrument shall be hardened and tempered to 430 to 490 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Grip the shaft of the retractor in one hand. Hold each blade In turn by other hand and try to 
straighten the blade by applying a heavy manual force. The blades shall resist this and show no sign of 
damage after test. 

6.2 Grip the shaft firmly In a vice close to Its junction with the large blade, with the blade protruding 
and facing upwards. Suspend a load of 180 N ( 18 kgf approximately) from the tip of the blade. Attain 
this load gradually and allow to act for 2 minutes. Similarly carry cue the test on the small blade using a 
load of 100 N ( 10 kgf approximately). After the test, the retractor shall show no sign of damage*

6.3 Corrosion Resisutnce — Scrub the retractor with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and then 
dip In 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the instrument, immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or yvet cotton wool. 

The solution shall be made up as follows: 

Copper sulphate (CUSO4.5H2O) 40 g 

Sulphuric add (H2S04)($pgr 1-84) lO^Og 

Water 90*0 ml 

No red stains or spots on the Instrument shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may 
be permitted. 

7* Marking — Each retractor shall be marlced with the manufacturer's name. Initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking-^ Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The retractors ihall be wrapped In moisture-proof paper or packed In polyethylene bags 
avoiding contact with one another.
